measured_quantities_and_default_features.median5_rtt: ms; median of preceding 5 completed RTTs
measured_quantities_and_default_features.std5_rtt: ms; SD of preceding 5 completed RTTs

information_budget.observation_window: Predict next probe RTT using only five previous completed RTTs and radio asof previous completion, <=0.5s old. No current response-completion timestamp, ICMPseq, cumulative average/loss, future gap, throughput or same-probe radio in inputs. Successful response conditional target; missing lost responses retained when inputs eligible. Expanded information budget: payload_B, last_rtt, mean5_rtt, mean3_rtt, trend_rtt, RSRP, RSRQ, last2_rtt, last3_rtt, median5_rtt, std5_rtt, route
information_budget.calibration_and_history: The previous five completed RTTs and causal radio observations constitute permitted online history; no response from the currently predicted probe is a calibration input. The preregistered parity-filter reference has no fitted coefficients and uses rhat=max(0,(3*last2+10*mean5-3*last-3*last3)/7). Other model coefficients, route offsets and transformations are fitted in their applicable outer training runs. The original55ms-breakpoint coefficients describe a separate historical comparator, not the current reference or a universal task calibration.
information_budget.source_selectors_policy: Only native observations underlying these declared quantities, within this timing/calibration contract. An archive hash is not permission to use every member or column. New channels require reviewed budget amendment.
information_budget.native_channel_rule: Resolve native channels through the bound preparation adapter and parent input units; extra channels are prohibited until explicit admission.

feature_policy: Alternative deterministic or training-fitted feature extraction is permitted within this source-level budget; feature names need not equal prepared columns. Declare exact member/column/window selectors and fitting groups.
target_policy: Target construction, eligible rows, groups and baseline predictions inherit the frozen parent unchanged.
review_policy: Prediction-only scoring validates declarations and numerical alignment; verified raw-information compliance requires bound computational and scientific review. This is not a sandbox or proof of training independence.
